definitions.explanation: The wife of an emperor. In the Japanese context, the wife of the reigning Emperor of Japan.

examples.japanese: {皇后|こうごう}{陛下|へいか}がお{言葉|ことば}を{述|の}べられた。
examples.english: Her Majesty the Empress delivered a speech.

examples.japanese: {天皇|てんのう}と{皇后|こうごう}が{被災地|ひさいち}を{訪問|ほうもん}された。
examples.english: The Emperor and Empress visited the disaster-affected area.

examples.japanese: {皇后|こうごう}は{国際|こくさい}{親善|しんぜん}のために{海外|かいがい}を{訪問|ほうもん}されることもある。
examples.english: The Empress sometimes visits foreign countries for the purpose of international goodwill.

notes:
{皇后|こうごう} refers specifically to the wife of a reigning emperor. In Japan, the full formal title is {皇后|こうごう}{陛下|へいか} (Her Majesty the Empress).

RELATED WORDS:
- {天皇|てんのう}: Emperor of Japan
- {皇太子|こうたいし}: Crown Prince
- {皇太后|こうたいごう}: Empress Dowager (mother of the reigning emperor)
- {女王|じょおう}: queen (ruling monarch, not consort)

When speaking about the imperial family, honorific language ({敬語|けいご}) is typically used. Verbs describing the empress's actions use special respectful forms such as 〜される or 〜になる.
